title: Kicking the habit alone at home as a teenager
summary: He suffered through three months of withdrawal in bed, unknown to his family.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: So I had to take it to the bed. Now, my Grandmother is working and my mother is working, I had the house by myself. So I feel like I had to have a bowel movement. I'd get up out of bed and sit on the side of the bed and then I catch a cramp in my back. I'd reach for it, it would then be in my leg. I'd reach for it, I'd get one in my neck. And before I could finish these cramps, I would have had the bowel movement there on the spot. Then I'd have to try and clean it up before my Grandmother get there. Then I'd start coughing and big bubbles of phlegm would be out in front of my face like a bubble gum. And it would pop and then I would go into nausea. And start vomiting. The house was stinking. But it wasn't stinking when my grandmother got home, (laughter) you can believe that.
How long did it take you to kick the habit?
About three months. I had youth in my favor.
But did you go through this constantly? The withdrawal?
Yeah, I stayed in bed, I'm telling you for three months. Because this is pure morphine.
What did your grandmother and mother think?

They didn't know it. They just thought I was sick, you know. So the woman that owned the drug store, Miss Ferguson, she knew that I loved malted milk with nutmeg in it, you know. So anytime that she had a delivery out that way she would always send me a malted milk. And malted milk and milk, you remember milk when it had cream on the top in the bottles. That was the only thing that would stay in my stomach, no solid foods at all for about a month and half before I could eat any solid food.
And then I was sorry I could because it wouldn't stay. Food wouldn't maintain the food value. It would just run straight through me. Well, I overcome that.
